review.tagline: Inference engine for Hugging Face LLMs with PagedAttention and continuous batching
review.summary: vLLM is a Python library and server for LLM inference. It manages attention KV memory with PagedAttention, batches requests continuously, and exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, plus the Anthropic Messages API and gRPC. It supports 200+ Hugging Face model architectures and runs on NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs, several CPU types, and other accelerators through plugins.
review.audience: Engineers running high-throughput LLM inference on GPUs or other accelerators
strengths: Continuous batching, chunked prefill, prefix caching and PagedAttention for high-throughput serving
Wide quantization support: FP8, NVFP4, INT4/INT8, GPTQ/AWQ, GGUF and others
Tensor, pipeline, data, expert and context parallelism for multi-GPU inference
Runs on NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPUs and x86/ARM/PowerPC CPUs, with plugins for TPU, Gaudi, Ascend
weaknesses: README gives no minimum RAM or VRAM figures
Several hardware targets depend on separate plugins rather than the core package
Large feature surface means many tuning options to learn
Server and library only, with no built-in chat UI
needs: Models: Hugging Face models, Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mixtral
